title: Make the coordinator tell you when threads block or finish
thesis: When a Claude Code project coordinator runs several threads, it tends to stay quiet until you ask. One instruction, saved to project memory, turns it into a proactive manager that posts a one-line note with a link whenever a thread is blocked or finishes something. The poster says it 10x'd their project experience.
instruction: I want you to send me more updates on what's going on with the threads including when they're blocked and when they finish something, save this to the project memory.
why: Saving it to project memory makes it stick across sessions, so you set it once. It's the same idea as Devin's live progress sidebar and session history: in multi-agent work, visibility into blocks and finishes is what lets one person steer many threads.
